fresh_validated_observations.topic: Crypto ETP flow timing rule replicated across SOL, ETH and BTC primary filings
fresh_validated_observations.label: PRIMARY-SOURCE METHOD LEARNING / CANONICALLY PROMOTED
observed_facts: Bitwise Solana Staking ETF's Aug. 13, 2026 SEC filing states that under its Agent Execution Model the Trust purchases SOL through Coinbase Prime on the evening of the Creation Order Date and may use trade credit; the product supports cash and in-kind creation mechanics with different order/settlement paths.

iShares Ethereum Trust ETF's Jul. 29, 2026 SEC filing states that in-kind creation orders cut off at 3:59 p.m. ET on trade date while cash creation orders cut off at 6:00 p.m. ET on the prior business day. For cash creations the Trust purchases ether through an Ether Trading Counterparty or Prime Execution Agent; final cash amounts are determined after NAV is struck and transactions settle.

Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund's Apr. 29, 2026 SEC prospectus states that creation orders may be cash or in kind. In-kind bitcoin is credited by the following business day; for cash creations the Trust instructs a bitcoin trading counterparty to purchase bitcoin with execution targeted to the Index price on the Purchase Order Date. Purchase-order cutoffs can precede 4:00 p.m. ET and NAV is released after the session.

These three independent product structures demonstrate that a single finalized daily net-flow number can combine different economic timing: investor secondary-market demand, AP inventory sourcing/hedging, trust-level asset acquisition, in-kind inventory transfer and post-session publication.
fresh_validated_observations.inference: Finalized daily ETP net flow is economically meaningful evidence of regulated-product demand, but it is not automatically a public pre-move predictor and is not equivalent to same-day exchange spot buying. The relevant causal time can precede, coincide with or follow the reported flow date depending on creation mode and AP/Trust execution mechanics.
fresh_validated_observations.method_rule: Store at least four separate timestamped states for ETP-flow research: (1) secondary-market demand/premium/volume; (2) AP order cutoff/acceptance; (3) underlying acquisition or hedging window and venue; (4) final published flow/NAV. Preserve observation timestamp and public-availability timestamp separately. Split cash and in-kind modes whenever defensible. Never score a finalized post-close flow as a same-session public pre-move predictor without evidence the relevant information was available earlier.
